next.goal_incomplete: Review the result, then spell out what is missing in the goal and run it again.
next.max_turns: Resume to continue the remaining work, or split the goal into smaller tasks and run again.
next.timeout: Split the task into smaller parts or raise the time limit, then run it again.
next.token_limit: Narrow the goal or reduce the input material, then run it again.
next.llm_error: Try again in a moment. If it keeps failing, pick another model or tell your administrator.
next.interrupted: Resume to pick up from where it stopped if the option is available; otherwise run the task again.
next.unknown: Check the full failure reason. If it fails the same way again, tell your administrator.
next.device_wait_expired: Connect Companion (or the CLI), then run the task again.
next.browser_takeover_expired: Hand the browser back from the Companion menu, then run the task again.
next.sandbox_unavailable: Run it again in a little while. An execution environment frees up once fewer tasks are running. If it keeps happening, tell your administrator.
next.interrupted_local_device: Reconnect Companion (or the CLI), then resume if the option is available, or run the task again.
next.lease_held_elsewhere: Run it again in a moment.
next.recovery_limit: You can resume from where it stopped. If it stops at the same point again, split the goal into smaller tasks and run it again, or tell your administrator.

impact.legacy: Older-style extension without a permission declaration (openmake-addon.json). It keeps network access as before. Re-approving records the current permissions; if a later update asks for broader permissions, only those are blocked.
impact.reviewRequired: An update asks for broader permissions than previously approved. Until you re-approve, only the added permissions are blocked (remote MCP servers are not installed and local MCP servers run without network). Existing features keep working.

permissions.recovery: Click Re-approve to use the blocked features. If you do not want to grant them, leave it as is or remove the extension.

permissions.approveFailed: Could not re-approve. Please try again shortly.
permissions.conflict: The extension was updated in the meantime and its requested permissions changed. Refresh and check again.

policyHelp.EXTERNAL_MODEL_POLICY: Allow/deny globs for external models as JSON. deny is unioned with global, allow is intersected — an org cannot lift a global block.
policyHelp.TOOL_APPROVAL_POLICY_MIN: Minimum approval policy for agent tasks. If stricter than the request, the minimum wins.
policyHelp.MCP_ALLOWED_SERVERS: Comma-separated MCP catalog template ids allowed for installation. Empty = no restriction.
policyHelp.BROWSER_SITE_POLICY: Browser site policy for this organization. The deny list is unioned with global. If global has an allow list, only entries present in both remain; if global is empty, the org list applies. Clear it to follow global.

adminOrganizations.configDescription: Exports or imports system settings (secrets excluded), global capability assignments, organizations and their policies as JSON. Import validates first; changes apply only after you press Apply.

adminCostRates.deleteConfirm: Delete this rate? The fallback rate will apply.

adminBridgeDevices.disconnectConfirm: Disconnect “{label}” of {email}? Requests from running local tasks will fail.
adminBridgeDevices.reconnectNote: Disconnect only closes the current connection. To keep a device from reconnecting, delete or deactivate the user's bridge API key — revoking a key also closes its connections immediately.

adminAgentTaskMetrics.title: Task metrics
adminAgentTaskMetrics.description: Success rate, duration, tokens and user interventions of agent tasks by executor. Covers tasks created in the period.
adminAgentTaskMetrics.empty: No tasks were created in this period.
adminAgentTaskMetrics.notes: Success rate = completed ÷ (completed + failed + cancelled). Duration runs from the first execution start to the end of finished tasks (from creation if no execution record). Interventions per task = (approval requests + questions + device waits + takeovers) ÷ tasks. Tools run under auto-approval are not counted as approval requests.
adminAgentTaskMetrics.thinkingNote: Older tasks (no value) count as Off. If the server's LLM_ENABLE_REASONING_EFFORT is off, Low/Medium/High all behave as "on".
adminAgentTaskMetrics.stabilityEmpty: No signals recorded in this period.
adminAgentTaskMetrics.stabilityQueueWait: Queue wait (accepted → running): {starts} starts, median {p50}, p95 {p95}
adminAgentTaskMetrics.stabilityNote: Covers all tasks created in the period. Counted from transition records and step text, so records written before a wording change may not be picked up.
